scope: Round 12. SRS.txt 'system - Chatbox with Gemini API': turn the existing Python chat box (be/chat.py, POST /api/chat, chat-1.2) into a RAG system: upload documents, chunk them, embed them, retrieve relevant chunks for each question, with retries. Builds on round 11 (archived as progress-feature-list/feature_list_11.json). Every business rule from rounds 1-11 stays.

source_requirements.text: i already built small chatbox with python and gemini, for now update to it RAG system, upload documents, chunk datas, retries ,... Req-1: Use gemini api settings i put in ./be/chat.py. Req-2: Only unit test and intergration test, e2e skip. Req-3: Database will save documents. All delete mean soft delete.

readings_to_confirm: Req-1: reuse chat.py's `client` (api key from GEMINI_API_KEY, timeout 30 s, retry attempts 4) and GEMINI_MODEL for answers; embeddings use the same client with an embedding model (gemini-embedding-001). No second Gemini config.

Req-3: documents and their chunks live in the existing Postgres (docker compose, DATABASE_URL), as new Prisma models KnowledgeDocument and KnowledgeChunk so migrations stay in one place. chat.py reads/writes them with psycopg (new Python dependency, listed in be/requirements.txt).
Embeddings are stored as a float array per chunk and ranked by cosine similarity in Python. shortcut: no pgvector (the postgres:16-alpine image lacks it); fine for hundreds of documents.
Uploads accept .txt and .md (UTF-8), max 2 MB per file. PDF/DOCX are out of scope unless asked.

Only staff and admin may upload, list and delete documents. They are identified by the same httpOnly access cookie the Node API sets (HS256, JWT_SECRET; the browser sends it to /api/chat and /api/docs through the Vite proxy), verified in Python, with status re-read from the users table. Chat itself stays open to every visitor, as today.
Delete = soft delete (deletedAt set); deleted documents and their chunks are never retrieved again but stay in the database.
No admin UI page in this round: the SRS asks for the RAG backend and tests only (Req-2 skips e2e). Uploading is done through the HTTP API.

Tests are Python unittest files next to chat_test.py in be/ (the repo's existing Python test home), not in e2e/: unit tests stub Gemini and the DB; integration tests use the real Postgres from docker compose with Gemini stubbed.
The uncommitted line `isinstance(message,  )` in be/chat.py makes every /api/chat call fail with TypeError; it is restored to `isinstance(message, dict)` as part of rag-1.5 unless the user objects.
rag-1.7 (user request 2026-11-14): the user is never taken from the request body or frontend state (forgeable); only from the verified access cookie. Guests get no account data.

conventions.tests: Python: be/<area>_test.py with unittest, run via `python -m unittest discover -s be -p "*_test.py"`. Integration tests skip with a clear message when DATABASE_URL is unreachable.
conventions.existing_tests: be/chat_test.py must keep passing unchanged except where a feature documents why.
conventions.run_all: ./init.sh must exit 0 and the Python suite must pass before a feature moves to passing. No new Playwright specs (Req-2).

features.title: Embeddings with retries
features.user_visible_behavior: None directly; a short Gemini hiccup while indexing or answering does not fail the request.
acceptance: embed(texts, task) calls client.models.embed_content from chat.py's client in batches (max 100 texts per call) and returns one vector per text, in order. Vectors have 768 dimensions (output_dimensionality).
On 429/5xx or timeout it retries with exponential backoff (e.g. 3 tries, 1 s / 2 s / 4 s, capped) on top of the SDK retries; other 4xx errors are not retried.
After the last failed try it raises one clear error; callers turn it into 503 (chat) or a failed upload, never a half-indexed document.

features.title: Upload, list and soft-delete knowledge documents
features.user_visible_behavior: Staff or admin can upload a .txt or .md file, see the list of documents with their chunk counts, and delete one; deleted documents stop informing the bot.
acceptance: POST /api/docs (multipart file, optional title) with a valid staff/admin access cookie stores the document, its chunks and their embeddings in one transaction and returns 201 with id, title, chunk count.
Missing/invalid/expired cookie, or a user whose status is locked/disabled/deleted -> 401; customer -> 403.
Wrong extension, non-UTF-8 content, empty file or over 2 MB -> 400/413 and nothing is stored.
If embedding fails after retries the upload returns 503 and no document or chunk row is left behind.
GET /api/docs lists non-deleted documents (id, title, filename, size, chunk count, createdAt), newest first.
DELETE /api/docs/<id> sets deletedAt (soft delete) and returns 204; deleting an unknown or already-deleted id -> 404.
verification: be/rag_docs_test.py (integration, real Postgres, Gemini stubbed): upload ok, auth 401/403, bad files, embed failure rolls back, list, soft delete keeps rows with deletedAt

features.srs_ref: SRS: update chat box to a RAG system
features.title: Chat answers grounded in uploaded documents
features.user_visible_behavior: When a visitor asks something covered by an uploaded document, the chat box answers from that document; with no relevant document it answers as before.
acceptance: POST /api/chat keeps its request/response shape, limits (MAX_TURNS, MAX_TEXT, rate limit) and error codes from chat-1.2.

The last user message is embedded (retrieval query task) and the top 4 chunks from non-deleted documents with cosine similarity above a threshold are added to the prompt as context, labelled with document titles.
The system prompt tells the bot to use the context when relevant and not to invent facts it is not given.
With no documents, or none above the threshold, the call to Gemini carries no context block.
If retrieval fails (db down or embedding fails after retries) the chat still answers without context and logs the failure.
The response includes `sources` (document titles used) only when excerpts were used; otherwise it is exactly {reply} as in chat-1.2. The existing ChatBox reads only `reply`.

features.srs_ref: User request 2026-11-14: bot serves the logged-in user only; guests are sent to login
features.title: Signed-in user context for the chat
features.user_visible_behavior: A logged-in customer can ask the chat about their own credit, bids and lots and gets real numbers; a guest asking about an account is pointed to the login page; nobody can get another customer's data.
acceptance: chat.py reads the access cookie on POST /api/chat and verifies it with JWT_SECRET (HS256, same rules as be/src/middleware/auth.ts readUser); the user's status is re-read from users and locked/disabled/deleted users count as guests.
Any user id, name or data in the request body is ignored.

For a signed-in user only, the prompt gets a short context block with that user's credit balance, held balance, their latest bids (auction title, amount, status) and their open lots; nothing about other users.
For a guest (no/invalid/expired cookie) the prompt gets no account data and tells the bot to send account questions to the login page.
If loading the user data fails, the chat still answers, treating the visitor as a guest, and logs the failure.
WEB_PROMPT has no claim the bot can see data it is not given; request/response shape and chat-1.2 limits unchanged.
verification: be/rag_user_test.py (unit: cookie valid/forged/expired/missing, body user ignored; integration on auction_test: signed-in user's own credit and bids reach the Gemini call, another user's do not, locked user = guest)
